t: Kasal boʻlib qolish: shamollash va uning belgilari

Adjectives, ten and possessives in the genitive; whose
Quantities and numbers with the genitive

t: Bolí yoki bolia; otdan yasalgan sifatlar (-ný, -ský)
Genitívda sifatlar, ten va egalik olmoshlari; kimning?

a2-u5-l1.nemas-chut-ist-zajtra.en.en: Do you fancy going skating tomorrow?

a2-u5-l1.nemas-chut-ist-zajtra.note.en: You know **Máš chuť…?** from unit 2; with **ne-** it's a gentler invitation. After ísť, korčuľovať sa often drops its sa: ísť korčuľovať. To someone you call vy: **Nemáte chuť**…?
a2-u5-l1.nemas-chut-ist-zajtra.note.t: **Máš chuť…?** ni 2-boʻlimdan bilasiz; **ne-** bilan u yumshoqroq taklif boʻladi, oʻzbekchadagi «…maysanmi?» kabi. Ísť dan keyin korčuľovať sa koʻpincha sa ni tushirib qoldiradi: ísť korčuľovať. «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: **Nemáte chuť**…?

a2-u5-l1.choice-prosim-ahoj-emma.questio.en: Emma's phone rings. What does Tomáš want?
a2-u5-l1.choice-prosim-ahoj-emma.questio.t: Emmaning telefoni jiringlayapti. Tomash nima istaydi?

en: To go skating with her tomorrow.
To go to the cinema tomorrow.
t: Ertaga u bilan konkida uchgani borishni.

a2-u5-l1.choice-ako-zdvihnut-telefon.que.en: Your phone rings. How can you answer it?

a2-u5-l1.choice-ako-zdvihnut-telefon.why.en: **Prosím?** is the usual way to answer the phone, like Haló? Nech sa páči is for handing something over.
a2-u5-l1.choice-ako-zdvihnut-telefon.why.t: **Prosím?** — telefonga odatda shunday javob beriladi, Haló? (Allo?) kabi. Nech sa páči (Marhamat) esa biror narsani uzatayotganda aytiladi.

a2-u5-l1.ako-sa-citis.note.en: **cítiť sa** = to feel, as in Necítim sa dobre; a short answer is dobre or zle. To someone you call vy: **Ako sa cítite?**
a2-u5-l1.ako-sa-citis.note.t: **cítiť sa** = oʻzini his qilmoq, Necítim sa dobre (Oʻzimni yaxshi his qilmayapman) dagi kabi; qisqa javob: dobre (yaxshi) yoki zle (yomon). «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: **Ako sa cítite?**

a2-u5-l1.fill-ako-sa-citite-pani.en.en: How are you feeling, Mrs Horváthová?
a2-u5-l1.fill-ako-sa-citite-pani.en.t: Oʻzingizni qanday his qilyapsiz, Horvatova xonim?

a2-u5-l1.fill-ako-sa-citite-pani.why.en: Emma calls her teacher **vy**, so the verb ends in **-te**: Ako sa **cítite**? Cítiš is for a friend, cíti for on or ona.
a2-u5-l1.fill-ako-sa-citite-pani.why.t: Emma oʻqituvchisiga vy (siz) deydi, shuning uchun feʼl **-te** bilan tugaydi: Ako sa **cítite**? Cítiš — doʻst uchun, cíti — on yoki ona (u) uchun.

a2-u5-l1.prechladla-som.en.en: I've caught a cold. (a woman speaking)

a2-u5-l1.prechladla-som.note.en: **prechladnúť** = to catch a cold. Like stretnúť, it swaps -núť for -ol, -la in the past.
a2-u5-l1.prechladla-som.note.t: **prechladnúť** = shamollamoq. stretnúť kabi, oʻtgan zamonda -núť oʻrniga -ol, -la keladi: prechladol, prechladla.

a2-u5-l1.mam-nadchu.note.en: **nádcha** is a cold in the nose. Like horúčka, it's what you have, the object, so -a changes to -u: mám nádch**u**.
a2-u5-l1.mam-nadchu.note.t: **nádcha** — tumov, burun oqishi. horúčka kabi, bu sizda bor narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun -a oʻrniga -u keladi: mám nádch**u**.

a2-u5-l1.kaslem.note.en: **kašľať** = to cough: kašlem, kašleš, kašle… The cough itself is **kašeľ**.
a2-u5-l1.kaslem.note.t: **kašľať** = yoʻtalmoq: kašlem, kašleš, kašle… Yoʻtalning oʻzi — **kašeľ**.

a2-u5-l1.fill-emma-kasle-a-ma.en.en: Emma has a cough and a runny nose.

a2-u5-l1.fill-emma-kasle-a-ma.why.en: The cold is what Emma has, the object of **má**, so nádcha changes -a to **-u**: má **nádchu**.
a2-u5-l1.fill-emma-kasle-a-ma.why.t: Tumov — Emmada bor narsa, **má** feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun nádcha -a ni **-u** ga almashtiradi: má **nádchu**.

a2-u5-l1.build-dakujem-za-pozvanie.promp.en: Thanks for the invitation, but I don't feel well.
a2-u5-l1.build-dakujem-za-pozvanie.promp.t: Taklif uchun rahmat, lekin oʻzimni yaxshi his qilmayapman.

en: **Cítiť sa** always comes with **sa**: necítim **sa** dobre.
You're talking about yourself (ja), and saying not: ne- + cítim = **necítim**. Cíti is on or ona.
t: **Cítiť sa** doim **sa** bilan keladi: necítim **sa** dobre.
Siz oʻzingiz haqingizda gapiryapsiz (ja) va inkor qilyapsiz: ne- + cítim = **necítim**. Cíti — on yoki ona (u) shakli.

a2-u5-l1.pozdrav-luciu-pozdravim.en.en: Say hello to Lucia (from me)! – I will.

a2-u5-l1.pozdrav-luciu-pozdravim.note.en: **Pozdrav**… (from pozdraviť, to greet) asks a friend to pass on your greetings, and **Pozdravím** promises to. To someone you call vy: **Pozdravte**…!
a2-u5-l1.pozdrav-luciu-pozdravim.note.t: **Pozdrav**… (pozdraviť — salomlashmoq feʼlidan) doʻstdan salomingizni yetkazishni soʻraydi, **Pozdravím** esa yetkazishga vaʼda beradi. «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: **Pozdravte**…!

a2-u5-l1.fill-pozdrav-mareka.en.en: Say hello to Marek! — I will.

a2-u5-l1.fill-pozdrav-mareka.why.en: You promise to pass the greeting on, so it's the ja form: **Pozdravím** (I'll greet him). Pozdrav is the request itself.
a2-u5-l1.fill-pozdrav-mareka.why.t: Siz salomni yetkazishga vaʼda beryapsiz, shuning uchun ja shakli: **Pozdravím** (salomingizni aytaman). Pozdrav esa iltimosning oʻzi.

a2-u5-l1.listen-kaslem-a-boli.en.en: I've got a cough and a sore throat.

a2-u5-l1.speak-necitim-sa-dobre-mam.en.en: I don't feel well, I've got a runny nose.
a2-u5-l1.speak-necitim-sa-dobre-mam.en.t: Oʻzimni yaxshi his qilmayapman, tumovim bor.

en: Tomáš is going skating with Lucia tomorrow.
Tomorrow Tomáš is going skating with Lucia.
t: Tomash ertaga Lusiya bilan konkida uchgani boradi.
Ertaga Tomash Lusiya bilan konkida uchgani boradi.
Tomash ertaga Lusiya bilan konki uchgani boradi.
Tomash ertaga Lusiya bilan konkida uchgani ketyapti.

a2-u5-l2.vyzeras-zle.note.en: You know **vyzerať** from Ako vyzerá? (unit 3); with dobre or zle it says how someone looks today. Vyzeráš dobre! = You look well! To someone you call vy: Vyzeráte zle.
a2-u5-l2.vyzeras-zle.note.t: **vyzerať** ni Ako vyzerá? (U qanday koʻrinishda?, 3-boʻlim) dan bilasiz; dobre yoki zle bilan u kimningdir bugun qanday koʻrinayotganini aytadi. Vyzeráš dobre! = Yaxshi koʻrinyapsan! «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: Vyzeráte zle.

a2-u5-l2.fill-marek-si-velmi.why.en: Marek is a man, so the adjective takes the masculine **-ý**: bled**ý**. Bledá is for a woman.
a2-u5-l2.fill-marek-si-velmi.why.t: Marek — erkak, shuning uchun sifat erkak jinsi qoʻshimchasi **-ý** ni oladi: bled**ý**. Bledá — ayol uchun.

a2-u5-l2.teplota.note.en: Akú máš teplotu? — Tridsaťosem stupňov. = What's your temperature? — 38 degrees. Over 38 it's **horúčka**, a fever; a **teplomer** is a thermometer.
a2-u5-l2.teplota.note.t: Akú máš teplotu? — Tridsaťosem stupňov. = Harorating necha? — Oʻttiz sakkiz daraja. 38 dan yuqorisi — **horúčka**, isitma; **teplomer** — termometr.

a2-u5-l2.choice-mam-teplotu.question.en: Emma looks at the thermometer. What does she say?
a2-u5-l2.choice-mam-teplotu.question.t: Emma termometrga qaraydi. U nima deydi?

a2-u5-l2.mala-by-si-ist.en.en: You should go to the doctor. (to a woman)

a2-u5-l2.mala-by-si-ist.note.en: Advice with **mal by si**, as in unit 4. **k lekárke** = to the (woman) doctor; to a man doctor, k lekárovi.
a2-u5-l2.mala-by-si-ist.note.t: Maslahat **mal by si** bilan, 4-boʻlimdagi kabi. **k lekárke** = shifokorga (ayol shifokorga); erkak shifokorga — k lekárovi.

a2-u5-l2.med.note.en: **Uvarím ti** čaj s medom a citrónom. = I'll make you tea with honey and lemon. Lucia's grandmother (**babka**) says it always helps: vždy **pomáha**.
a2-u5-l2.med.note.t: **Uvarím ti** čaj s medom a citrónom. = Senga asal va limonli choy damlab beraman. Lusiyaning buvisi (**babka**) aytishicha, u doim yordam beradi: vždy **pomáha**.

a2-u5-l2.build-uvarim-ti-caj.prompt.en: I'll make you tea with honey.

en: After **s** (with), the noun takes the “with” form: med → s **medom**.
The tea is for you (ty), so it's **ti**: uvarím **ti** čaj. Mi would be for me.
t: **S** (bilan) dan keyin ot «bilan» shaklini (inštrumentál) oladi: med → s **medom**.
Choy sen uchun (ty), shuning uchun **ti** (senga): uvarím **ti** čaj. Mi — «menga» boʻlardi.

a2-u5-l2.rada-ti-pomozem.en.en: I'm happy to help you. (a woman speaking)

a2-u5-l2.rada-ti-pomozem.note.en: Rád, rada + a verb, as in Rada prídem! (unit 3). **pomôcť** points to the future: pomôžem = I'll help.
a2-u5-l2.rada-ti-pomozem.note.t: Rád, rada + feʼl, Rada prídem! (Mamnuniyat bilan kelaman!, 3-boʻlim) dagi kabi. **pomôcť** kelasi zamonni bildiradi: pomôžem = yordam beraman.

a2-u5-l2.fill-lucia-ti-rada.en.en: Lucia will be happy to help you.

a2-u5-l2.fill-lucia-ti-rada.why.en: Lucia is a woman, so it's **rada**. Rád is for a man, radi for a group.
a2-u5-l2.fill-lucia-ti-rada.why.t: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun **rada**. Rád — erkak uchun, radi — bir guruh uchun.

a2-u5-l2.ordinacne-hodiny.note.en: Lekárka **ordinuje** od siedmej do tretej. = The doctor sees patients from seven to three. Her surgery is her **ordinácia**.
a2-u5-l2.ordinacne-hodiny.note.t: Lekárka **ordinuje** od siedmej do tretej. = Shifokor soat yettidan uchgacha bemorlarni qabul qiladi. Shifokor bemorlarni qabul qiladigan xona — **ordinácia**.

en: Our doctor sees patients at 7 and at 3.
Our doctor sees patients from 7 to 3.
t: Shifokorimiz bemorlarni soat 7 da va 3 da qabul qiladi.
Shifokorimiz bemorlarni soat 7 dan 3 gacha qabul qiladi.

a2-u5-l2.build-mala-by-si.prompt.en: You should go to the doctor, Emma.

en: Emma is a woman, so the advice takes the feminine form: **mala** by si. Mal is for a man.
Going to someone is **k** + the to-whom form: **k lekárke**.
t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun maslahat ayol jinsi shaklida: **mala** by si. Mal — erkak uchun.
Kimningdir oldiga borish — **k** + «kimga?» shakli (datív): **k lekárke**, oʻzbekchadagi «shifokorga» kabi.

a2-u5-l2.build-mam-teplotu-tridsatosem.p.en: I've got a temperature of 38 degrees.

en: The temperature is what you have, the object of mám, so teplota changes -a to **-u**: mám **teplotu**.
From five up the noun takes a special form, as in päť eur: tridsaťosem **stupňov**. Stupne goes with 2, 3 and 4.
t: Harorat — sizda bor narsa, mám feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun teplota -a ni **-u** ga almashtiradi: mám **teplotu**.
Beshdan boshlab ot alohida shaklda keladi, päť eur dagi kabi: tridsaťosem **stupňov**. Stupne — 2, 3 va 4 bilan.

a2-u5-l2.speak-vyzeras-zle-si.en.t: Koʻrinishing yaxshi emas, ranging oqarib ketibdi.

en: Grandma says that tea with honey always helps.
Grandma says tea with honey always helps.
Granny says that tea with honey always helps.
Granny says tea with honey always helps.
t: Buvim asalli choy doim yordam beradi deydi.
Buvim aytadiki, asalli choy doim yordam beradi.
Buvi asalli choy doim yordam beradi deydi.
Buvim asalli choy doim foyda qiladi deydi.

a2-u5-l3.sestricka.note.en: Officially **zdravotná sestra**; patients usually say **sestrička**. Sestra is also a sister.
a2-u5-l3.sestricka.note.t: Rasmiy nomi — **zdravotná sestra**; bemorlar odatda **sestrička** deydi. Sestra yana «opa, singil» degani ham.

a2-u5-l3.preukaz-poistenca.note.en: **poistenec** = an insured person. Emma has a European card: **európsky preukaz zdravotného poistenia**.
a2-u5-l3.preukaz-poistenca.note.t: **poistenec** = sugʻurtalangan odam. Emmada Yevropa kartasi bor: **európsky preukaz zdravotného poistenia** (Yevropa tibbiy sugʻurta kartasi).

a2-u5-l3.choice-mate-preukaz-poistenca.q.en: What does the nurse want to see?

a2-u5-l3.poistovna.note.en: **zdravotná poisťovňa** = health insurance company. Emma's is in Ireland: Moja poisťovňa je v Írsku.
a2-u5-l3.poistovna.note.t: **zdravotná poisťovňa** = tibbiy sugʻurta kompaniyasi. Emmaniki Irlandiyada: Moja poisťovňa je v Írsku.

a2-u5-l3.fill-mam-europsky-preukaz.en.en: I've got a European health insurance card.
a2-u5-l3.fill-mam-europsky-preukaz.en.t: Menda Yevropa tibbiy sugʻurta kartasi bor.

a2-u5-l3.fill-mam-europsky-preukaz.why.en: The card is what you have, the object. Preukaz is a masculine thing, so it doesn't change: mám **preukaz**.
a2-u5-l3.fill-mam-europsky-preukaz.why.t: Karta — sizda bor narsa, toʻldiruvchi. Preukaz — erkak jinsidagi narsa, shuning uchun oʻzgarmaydi: mám **preukaz**.

a2-u5-l3.cakaren.note.en: From **čakať** (to wait). V čakárni = in the waiting room.

a2-u5-l3.fill-emma-caka-v.en.en: Emma is waiting in the waiting room.

a2-u5-l3.fill-emma-caka-v.why.en: **V** answering “where?” takes the locative. Čakáreň ends in a soft ň, so it takes **-i** and drops its e: v **čakárni**, like v kaviarni.
a2-u5-l3.fill-emma-caka-v.why.t: «Qayerda?» savoliga javob beruvchi **v** lokál (oʻrin-payt kelishigi) talab qiladi. Čakáreň yumshoq ň bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun **-i** oladi va e ni tushiradi: v **čakárni**, v kaviarni kabi.

a2-u5-l3.dalsi-prosim.note.en: The nurse or the doctor calls in the next patient. Then: **Poďte ďalej.** (Come in.)
a2-u5-l3.dalsi-prosim.note.t: Hamshira yoki shifokor navbatdagi bemorni shunday chaqiradi. Keyin: **Poďte ďalej.** (Kiring.)

a2-u5-l3.choice-sestricka-otvori-dvere.q.en: The nurse opens the door to call in the next patient. What does she say?
a2-u5-l3.choice-sestricka-otvori-dvere.q.t: Hamshira navbatdagi bemorni chaqirish uchun eshikni ochadi. U nima deydi?

a2-u5-l3.lekar-a-pacient.note.en: Patients call a doctor **pán doktor** or **pani doktorka**.
a2-u5-l3.lekar-a-pacient.note.t: Bemorlar shifokorga **pán doktor** (erkakka) yoki **pani doktorka** (ayolga) deb murojaat qiladi, oʻzbekchadagi «doktor» kabi.

a2-u5-l3.co-vam-je.note.en: The doctor's first question. To a friend: **Čo ti je?** You may also hear: **Aký máte problém?**
a2-u5-l3.co-vam-je.note.t: Shifokorning birinchi savoli. Doʻstga: **Čo ti je?** (Senga nima boʻldi?) Yana shunday eshitishingiz mumkin: **Aký máte problém?** (Nimadan shikoyat qilyapsiz?)

a2-u5-l3.fill-lucia-co-ti.en.en: Lucia, what's the matter? You look ill.
a2-u5-l3.fill-lucia-co-ti.en.t: Lusiya, senga nima boʻldi? Koʻrinishing yaxshi emas.

a2-u5-l3.fill-lucia-co-ti.why.en: Lucia is a friend, so it's ty: Čo **ti** je? Čo vám je? is for someone you call vy, like a patient.
a2-u5-l3.fill-lucia-co-ti.why.t: Lusiya — doʻst, shuning uchun ty: Čo **ti** je? Čo vám je? — vy (siz) deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga, masalan bemorga.

a2-u5-l3.build-emma-caka-na.prompt.en: Emma is waiting for the doctor.

en: **Čakať na** takes the object form, so lekárka changes -a to **-u**: na **lekárku**.
Waiting for someone is **čakať na** + the object form: čaká **na** lekárku.
t: **Čakať na** toʻldiruvchi shaklini talab qiladi, shuning uchun lekárka -a ni **-u** ga almashtiradi: na **lekárku**.
Kimnidir kutish — **čakať na** + toʻldiruvchi shakli: čaká **na** lekárku. Oʻzbekchada predlog yoʻq («shifokorni kutyapti»), slovakchada esa na kerak.

a2-u5-l3.speak-som-z-irska.en.en: I'm from Ireland, I've got a European card.
a2-u5-l3.speak-som-z-irska.en.t: Men Irlandiyadanman, menda Yevropa kartasi bor.

en: Five patients are sitting in the waiting room.
There are five patients sitting in the waiting room.
There are five patients in the waiting room.
t: Kutish xonasida besh nafar bemor oʻtiribdi.

a2-u5-l4.vyzlecte-sa.note.en: The doctor's instructions are vy forms ending in -te; learn them as phrases for now. **Vyzlečte sa do pása.** = Undress to the waist.
a2-u5-l4.vyzlecte-sa.note.t: Shifokorning koʻrsatmalari -te bilan tugaydigan vy shakllari; hozircha ularni tayyor ibora sifatida yodlang. **Vyzlečte sa do pása.** = Belingizgacha yechining.

a2-u5-l4.dychajte-zhlboka.note.en: **dýchať** = to breathe, **zhlboka** = deeply. The doctor listens to your **hruď** (chest), then: **Nedýchajte.** = Hold your breath.
a2-u5-l4.dychajte-zhlboka.note.t: **dýchať** = nafas olmoq, **zhlboka** = chuqur. Shifokor koʻkragingizni (**hruď**) eshitadi, keyin: **Nedýchajte.** = Nafasingizni ushlab turing.

a2-u5-l4.choice-lekarka-chce-vyzlecte.qu.en: The doctor wants Emma to take her top off. What does she say?
a2-u5-l4.choice-lekarka-chce-vyzlecte.qu.t: Shifokor Emmadan ustki kiyimini yechishini soʻramoqchi. U nima deydi?

a2-u5-l4.ukazte-mi-hrdlo.note.en: Then: **Otvorte ústa** (open your mouth) and **Povedzte á.** (say ah). Or: Ukážte jazyk. (Show me your tongue.)
a2-u5-l4.ukazte-mi-hrdlo.note.t: Keyin: **Otvorte ústa** (ogʻzingizni oching) va **Povedzte á.** («a» deng). Yoki: Ukážte jazyk. (Tilingizni koʻrsating.)

a2-u5-l4.build-otvorte-usta-a.prompt.en: Open your mouth and say ah.

en: You open your mouth, **ústa**, so the doctor can see your throat (hrdlo).
The doctor's phrase is **Otvorte** ústa, as on the card. Otvoriť (to open) is the infinitive, not what she says.
t: Siz ogʻzingizni — **ústa** ni ochasiz, shifokor esa tomogʻingizni (hrdlo) koʻradi.
Shifokorning iborasi — **Otvorte** ústa, kartochkadagi kabi. Otvoriť (ochmoq) — infinitív, shifokor bunday demaydi.

a2-u5-l4.angina.note.en: **Máte angínu.** = You've got tonsillitis. It isn't **chrípka** (flu) or **zápal pľúc** (pneumonia).
a2-u5-l4.angina.note.t: **Máte angínu.** = Sizda angina. Bu **chrípka** (gripp) ham, **zápal pľúc** (zotiljam) ham emas.

a2-u5-l4.fill-mate-anginu.why.en: The illness is what you have, the object of **máte**, so angína changes -a to **-u**: máte **angínu**.
a2-u5-l4.fill-mate-anginu.why.t: Kasallik — sizda bor narsa, **máte** feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun angína -a ni **-u** ga almashtiradi: máte **angínu**.

a2-u5-l4.mam-chripku.note.en: **chrípka** = flu. Other things a doctor may find: **vysoký tlak** (high blood pressure), **kŕče** (cramps).
a2-u5-l4.mam-chripku.note.t: **chrípka** = gripp. Shifokor topishi mumkin boʻlgan boshqa narsalar: **vysoký tlak** (yuqori qon bosimi), **kŕče** (mushak tortishishi).

a2-u5-l4.fill-nemam-anginu-mam.en.en: I haven't got tonsillitis, I've got flu.

a2-u5-l4.fill-nemam-anginu-mam.why.en: The illness is what you have, the object of **mám**, so chrípka changes -a to **-u**: mám **chrípku**, like mám angínu.
a2-u5-l4.fill-nemam-anginu-mam.why.t: Kasallik — sizda bor narsa, **mám** feʼlining toʻldiruvchisi, shuning uchun chrípka -a ni **-u** ga almashtiradi: mám **chrípku**, mám angínu kabi.

a2-u5-l4.antibiotika.note.en: **Napíšem vám antibiotiká.** = I'll prescribe you antibiotics. **Tu je recept.** = Here's the prescription.
a2-u5-l4.antibiotika.note.t: **Napíšem vám antibiotiká.** = Sizga antibiotik yozib beraman. **Tu je recept.** = Mana retsept.

a2-u5-l4.pite-vela-tekutin.note.en: **tekutina** = a liquid, like **voda** (water) or čaj; after veľa it's tekutín, a form this unit explains. Also: **Oddychujte.** or **Musíte si oddýchnuť.** = Rest.
a2-u5-l4.pite-vela-tekutin.note.t: **tekutina** = suyuqlik, masalan **voda** (suv) yoki čaj; veľa dan keyin u tekutín boʻladi — bu shaklni shu boʻlim tushuntiradi. Yana: **Oddychujte.** yoki **Musíte si oddýchnuť.** = Dam oling.

a2-u5-l4.build-oddychujte-a-pite.prompt.en: Rest and drink plenty of fluids.
a2-u5-l4.build-oddychujte-a-pite.prompt.t: Dam oling va koʻp suyuqlik iching.

en: After **veľa** (a lot of), Slovak uses a special form of the noun: veľa **tekutín**. This unit's grammar lessons explain it.
The doctor's phrase is **Pite** veľa tekutín, as on the card. Piť (to drink) is the infinitive, not what she says.
t: **Veľa** (koʻp) dan keyin slovak tilida otning alohida shakli ishlatiladi: veľa **tekutín**. Buni shu boʻlimning grammatika darslari tushuntiradi.
Shifokorning iborasi — **Pite** veľa tekutín, kartochkadagi kabi. Piť (ichmoq) — infinitív, shifokor bunday demaydi.

a2-u5-l4.pridte-na-kontrolu.note.en: **O týždeň** príďte na kontrolu. = Come back for a check-up in a week. **kontrola** = check-up.
a2-u5-l4.pridte-na-kontrolu.note.t: **O týždeň** príďte na kontrolu. = Bir haftadan keyin qayta koʻrikka keling. **kontrola** = qayta koʻrik.

a2-u5-l4.fill-o-tyzden-pridte.en.en: Come back for a check-up in a week.
a2-u5-l4.fill-o-tyzden-pridte.en.t: Bir haftadan keyin qayta koʻrikka keling.

a2-u5-l4.fill-o-tyzden-pridte.why.en: **O** + a length of time means “in”, with the object form: o hodinu, o **týždeň**.
a2-u5-l4.fill-o-tyzden-pridte.why.t: **O** + vaqt oraligʻi «…dan keyin» degani, toʻldiruvchi shakli bilan: o hodinu (bir soatdan keyin), o **týždeň**.

en: The doctor prescribed me antibiotics and gave me a prescription.
The doctor prescribed antibiotics and gave me a prescription.
t: Shifokor menga antibiotik yozib, retsept berdi.
Shifokor menga antibiotik yozib berdi va retsept berdi.
Shifokor menga antibiotiklar yozib, retsept berdi.
Shifokor antibiotik yozib berdi va menga retsept berdi.

a2-u5-l5.lekarnicka.note.en: She works **v lekárni**, in the pharmacy (lekáreň).

a2-u5-l5.na-recept-bez-receptu.note.en: **bez** = without. Medicines you can buy without a prescription are sold at the **voľný predaj** window.
a2-u5-l5.na-recept-bez-receptu.note.t: **bez** = …siz, oʻzbekchadagi -siz qoʻshimchasi kabi: bez receptu — retseptsiz. Retseptsiz sotiladigan dorilar **voľný predaj** (erkin savdo) oynasida sotiladi.

en: You need a prescription for antibiotics.
You don't need a prescription for antibiotics.

a2-u5-l5.tabletka.note.en: Plural: tabletky. **užívať** = to take (medicine): Užívajte jednu tabletku. = Take one tablet.
a2-u5-l5.tabletka.note.t: Koʻplikda: tabletky. **užívať** = (dori) ichmoq, qabul qilmoq: Užívajte jednu tabletku. = Bittadan tabletka iching.

a2-u5-l5.fill-tieto-lieky-su.why.en: **Na recept** (on prescription) uses the object form, so recept doesn't change. Bez takes another form: bez **receptu**.
a2-u5-l5.fill-tieto-lieky-su.why.t: **Na recept** (retsept bilan) toʻldiruvchi shaklini ishlatadi, shuning uchun recept oʻzgarmaydi. Bez esa boshqa shaklni talab qiladi: bez **receptu**.

a2-u5-l5.trikrat-denne.note.en: **denne** = a day, daily. It takes -krát like dvakrát týždenne (unit 4): **raz** denne (once a day), dvakrát denne, trikrát denne…
a2-u5-l5.trikrat-denne.note.t: **denne** = kuniga, har kuni. U dvakrát týždenne (haftasiga ikki marta, 4-boʻlim) kabi -krát bilan keladi: **raz** denne (kuniga bir marta), dvakrát denne, trikrát denne…

a2-u5-l5.fill-antibiotika-uzivajte.en.en: Take the antibiotics three times a day.

a2-u5-l5.fill-antibiotika-uzivajte.why.en: To say how many times, add **-krát**: raz, dvakrát, **trikrát** denne.
a2-u5-l5.fill-antibiotika-uzivajte.why.t: Necha marta ekanini aytish uchun **-krát** qoʻshiladi, oʻzbekchadagi «marta» kabi: raz, dvakrát, **trikrát** denne.

a2-u5-l5.choice-uzivajte-dve-tabletky.qu.en: The pharmacist says: Užívajte dve tabletky dvakrát denne. How many tablets a day is that?
a2-u5-l5.choice-uzivajte-dve-tabletky.qu.t: Farmatsevt aytadi: Užívajte dve tabletky dvakrát denne. Bu kuniga nechta tabletka?

a2-u5-l5.choice-uzivajte-dve-tabletky.wh.en: **Dvakrát denne** is twice a day, and each time **dve tabletky**: four in all.
a2-u5-l5.choice-uzivajte-dve-tabletky.wh.t: **Dvakrát denne** — kuniga ikki marta, har safar **dve tabletky** (ikkita tabletka): jami toʻrtta.

a2-u5-l5.build-uzivajte-jednu-tabletku.p.en: Take one tablet three times a day.
a2-u5-l5.build-uzivajte-jednu-tabletku.p.t: Kuniga uch marta bittadan tabletka iching.

en: The tablet is the object, so jedna changes like tabletka: **jednu** tabletku.
One tablet, the object: tabletka changes -a to **-u**. Tabletky is the plural.
t: Tabletka — toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun jedna ham tabletka kabi oʻzgaradi: **jednu** tabletku.
Bitta tabletka, toʻldiruvchi: tabletka -a ni **-u** ga almashtiradi. Tabletky — koʻplik.

a2-u5-l5.balenie.note.en: V jednom balení je dvadsať tabletiek. = There are twenty tablets in one pack.
a2-u5-l5.balenie.note.t: V jednom balení je dvadsať tabletiek. = Bir qadoqda yigirmata tabletka bor.

en: You take twenty tablets a day.

a2-u5-l5.fill-lekarnicka-pracuje-v.en.en: The pharmacist works in a pharmacy.

a2-u5-l5.fill-lekarnicka-pracuje-v.why.en: **V** answering “where?” takes the locative. Lekáreň ends in a soft ň, so it takes **-i** and drops its e: v **lekárni**.
a2-u5-l5.fill-lekarnicka-pracuje-v.why.t: «Qayerda?» savoliga javob beruvchi **v** lokál talab qiladi. Lekáreň yumshoq ň bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun **-i** oladi va e ni tushiradi: v **lekárni**.

a2-u5-l5.speak-mam-recept-od.en.en: Hello, I've got a prescription from the doctor.
a2-u5-l5.speak-mam-recept-od.en.t: Assalomu alaykum, menda shifokordan retsept bor.

en: Emma is paying by card at the pharmacy.
Emma pays by card at the pharmacy.
At the pharmacy Emma pays by card.

a2-u5-l6.sirup-proti-kaslu.note.en: **Proti** + the dative, as in čaj proti chrípke (unit 3): kašeľ → proti **kašľu**. So also: niečo proti nádche, something for a runny nose.
a2-u5-l6.sirup-proti-kaslu.note.t: **Proti** + datív (joʻnalish kelishigi), čaj proti chrípke (grippga qarshi choy, 3-boʻlim) dagi kabi — oʻzbekchadagi «…ga qarshi»: kašeľ → proti **kašľu**. Shuningdek: niečo proti nádche — tumovga qarshi biror narsa.

a2-u5-l6.kvapky-do-nosa.note.en: **kvapka** = a drop, **nos** = nose: do nosa, into the nose.
a2-u5-l6.kvapky-do-nosa.note.t: **kvapka** = tomchi, **nos** = burun: do nosa — burunga (burun ichiga).

a2-u5-l6.co-mi-odporucate.note.en: **odporúčať**, **odporučiť** = to recommend. The pharmacist answers: **Odporúčam vám** tento sirup.
a2-u5-l6.co-mi-odporucate.note.t: **odporúčať**, **odporučiť** = tavsiya qilmoq. Farmatsevt javob beradi: **Odporúčam vám** tento sirup. (Sizga shu siropni tavsiya qilaman.)

a2-u5-l6.fill-odporucam-vam-tento.why.en: You recommend something **to** someone, so the person takes the to-whom form: odporúčam **vám**, like **mi** in Čo mi odporúčate?
a2-u5-l6.fill-odporucam-vam-tento.why.t: Biror narsani **kimgadir** tavsiya qilasiz, shuning uchun odam «kimga?» shaklida keladi: odporúčam **vám** (sizga), Čo mi odporúčate? dagi **mi** (menga) kabi.

a2-u5-l6.vitaminy.note.en: Máte aj **nejaké** vitamíny? = Do you have any vitamins too? One vitamin: vitamín.
a2-u5-l6.vitaminy.note.t: Máte aj **nejaké** vitamíny? = Biror vitamin ham bormi? Bitta vitamin: vitamín.

en: You call the pharmacist **vy**, so it's **Máte**…? Máš is for a friend.
More than one vitamin: the plural, **vitamíny**.
t: Farmatsevtga vy (siz) deysiz, shuning uchun **Máte**…? Máš — doʻst uchun.

a2-u5-l6.to-si-nemozem-dovolit.note.en: **dovoliť si** = to afford. Si takes second place, right after to: To **si** nemôžem dovoliť.
a2-u5-l6.to-si-nemozem-dovolit.note.t: **dovoliť si** = qurbi yetmoq. Si ikkinchi oʻrinda, to dan keyin turadi: To **si** nemôžem dovoliť.

a2-u5-l6.build-tie-vitaminy-su.prompt.en: Those vitamins are expensive, I can't afford them.
a2-u5-l6.build-tie-vitaminy-su.prompt.t: Bu vitaminlar qimmat, ularga pulim yetmaydi.

en: To afford is **dovoliť si**, with si: to **si** nemôžem dovoliť.
Vitamíny are plural things, so the adjective ends in **-é**: sú **drahé**.
t: Qurbi yetmoq — **dovoliť si**, si bilan: to **si** nemôžem dovoliť.
Vitamíny — koʻplikdagi narsalar, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: sú **drahé**.

a2-u5-l6.nechaj-tak-ja-to.note.en: Said when you insist on paying for a friend. To ask what you owe a friend: **Koľko ti dám?**
a2-u5-l6.nechaj-tak-ja-to.note.t: Doʻstingiz uchun oʻzingiz toʻlamoqchi boʻlsangiz, shunday deysiz. Doʻstingizdan qancha berishingiz kerakligini soʻrash: **Koľko ti dám?** (Senga qancha beray?)

a2-u5-l6.choice-lucia-chce-zaplatit.ques.en: Lucia wants to pay for Emma's vitamins. What does she say?
a2-u5-l6.choice-lucia-chce-zaplatit.ques.t: Lusiya Emmaning vitaminlari uchun oʻzi toʻlamoqchi. U nima deydi?

a2-u5-l6.fill-dakujem-kolko-ti.en.en: Thanks! How much do I owe you?

a2-u5-l6.fill-dakujem-kolko-ti.why.en: Emma is asking Lucia, a friend, so it's ty: **ti**. Koľko vám dám? is for someone you call vy.
a2-u5-l6.fill-dakujem-kolko-ti.why.t: Emma doʻsti Lusiyadan soʻrayapti, shuning uchun ty: **ti** (senga). Koľko vám dám? — vy (siz) deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga.

a2-u5-l6.build-mate-nieco-proti.prompt.en: Have you got anything for a cough?
a2-u5-l6.build-mate-nieco-proti.prompt.t: Sizda yoʻtalga qarshi biror narsa bormi?

en: After **proti** (against), kašeľ changes, as in sirup proti **kašľu**.
You call the pharmacist **vy**, so it's **Máte**…? Máš is for a friend.
t: **Proti** (qarshi) dan keyin kašeľ oʻzgaradi, sirup proti **kašľu** dagi kabi.
Farmatsevtga vy (siz) deysiz, shuning uchun **Máte**…? Máš — doʻst uchun.

a2-u5-l6.speak-co-mi-odporucate.en.en: What do you recommend for a cough?

en: Emma forgot her money at home.
Emma has forgotten her money at home.
Emma left her money at home.
Use the nose drops twice a day.
Use nose drops twice a day.
Take the nose drops twice a day.
t: Burun tomchisini kuniga ikki marta tomizing.
Burun tomchisini kuniga ikki mahal tomizing.
Burun tomchisidan kuniga ikki marta foydalaning.

a2-u5-l7.lyzovat.note.en: From **lyžovať sa** (unit 2). After ísť the sa is often left out: ísť lyžovať. Ísť **na hory** = to go to the mountains; **na lyžovačke** = on a skiing trip.
a2-u5-l7.lyzovat.note.t: **lyžovať sa** (2-boʻlim) soʻzidan. Ísť dan keyin sa koʻpincha tushib qoladi: ísť lyžovať (changʻi uchgani bormoq). Ísť **na hory** = togʻlarga bormoq; **na lyžovačke** = changʻi sayohatida.

a2-u5-l7.choice-v-sobotu-idu.question.en: What are Marek and Tomáš doing on Saturday?
a2-u5-l7.choice-v-sobotu-idu.question.t: Marek va Tomash shanba kuni nima qilishadi?

a2-u5-l7.spadol-som.note.en: You know **spadnúť** from Emma's skating in unit 2: spadol, spadla.
a2-u5-l7.spadol-som.note.t: **spadnúť** ni 2-boʻlimdagi Emmaning konki uchishidan bilasiz: spadol, spadla.

a2-u5-l7.zlomil-som-si-ruku.en.en: I've broken my arm. (a man speaking)

a2-u5-l7.zlomil-som-si-ruku.note.en: **zlomiť si** + a part of the body: si does the job of “my”. **ruka** is the hand and the arm; **noha** the foot and the leg.
a2-u5-l7.zlomil-som-si-ruku.note.t: **zlomiť si** + tana aʼzosi: si «oʻzimning» vazifasini bajaradi, oʻzbekchadagi -im qoʻshimchasi kabi. **ruka** — ham kaft, ham butun qoʻl, **noha** — ham oyoq panjasi, ham butun oyoq, xuddi oʻzbekchadagi «qoʻl» va «oyoq» kabi.

a2-u5-l7.fill-marek-si-zlomil.why.en: The arm is what he broke, the object, so ruka changes -a to **-u**: zlomil si **ruku**.
a2-u5-l7.fill-marek-si-zlomil.why.t: Qoʻl — u sindirgan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun ruka -a ni **-u** ga almashtiradi: zlomil si **ruku**.

a2-u5-l7.zavolaj-sanitku.note.en: **sanitka** = ambulance. The emergency number in Slovakia, as in the whole EU, is **112**, a free call; the ambulance alone is 155.
a2-u5-l7.zavolaj-sanitku.note.t: **sanitka** = tez yordam mashinasi. Slovakiyada, butun Yevropa Ittifoqidagi kabi, favqulodda vaziyatlar raqami — **112**, qoʻngʻiroq bepul; faqat tez yordam — 155 (Oʻzbekistondagi 103 kabi).

a2-u5-l7.choice-marek-nemoze-vstat.quest.en: Marek can't get up. Which number does Tomáš call?
a2-u5-l7.choice-marek-nemoze-vstat.quest.t: Marek oʻrnidan tura olmayapti. Tomash qaysi raqamga qoʻngʻiroq qiladi?

a2-u5-l7.choice-marek-nemoze-vstat.why.en: **112** is the emergency number all over the EU, Slovakia included. 911 is the American number, 999 the British and Irish one.
a2-u5-l7.choice-marek-nemoze-vstat.why.t: **112** — butun Yevropa Ittifoqida, jumladan Slovakiyada favqulodda vaziyatlar raqami. 911 — Amerika raqami, 999 — Britaniya va Irlandiya raqami.

a2-u5-l7.nemocnica.note.en: **v nemocnici** = in hospital; the ambulance takes Marek **do nemocnice**, to the hospital.
a2-u5-l7.nemocnica.note.t: **v nemocnici** = kasalxonada; tez yordam Marekni **do nemocnice** — kasalxonaga olib boradi.

a2-u5-l7.build-marek-je-v.prompt.en: Marek is in hospital, he's broken his arm.
a2-u5-l7.build-marek-je-v.prompt.t: Marek kasalxonada, u qoʻlini sindirib oldi.

en: In hospital answers “where?”, so **v** takes the locative: v **nemocnici**, like v knižnici.
Breaking a part of your own body is **zlomiť si**: zlomil **si** ruku.
t: Kasalxonada — «qayerda?» savoliga javob, shuning uchun **v** lokál talab qiladi: v **nemocnici**, v knižnici kabi.
Oʻz tana aʼzoingizni sindirish — **zlomiť si**: zlomil **si** ruku.

a2-u5-l7.pohotovost.note.en: The hospital's emergency department, and the doctor on call at night and at weekends, when your own doctor isn't seeing patients.
a2-u5-l7.pohotovost.note.t: Kasalxonaning shoshilinch yordam boʻlimi, shuningdek oʻz shifokoringiz qabul qilmaydigan paytda — kechasi va dam olish kunlari ishlaydigan navbatchi shifokor.

a2-u5-l7.fill-lekarka-dnes-neordinuje.en.en: The doctor isn't seeing patients today, we have to go to A&E.
a2-u5-l7.fill-lekarka-dnes-neordinuje.en.t: Shifokor bugun qabul qilmaydi, shoshilinch yordam boʻlimiga borishimiz kerak.

a2-u5-l7.fill-lekarka-dnes-neordinuje.wh.en: Going there: **na** + the object form. Pohotovosť is feminine and ends in a consonant, so it doesn't change: na **pohotovosť**. Na pohotovosti is being there.
a2-u5-l7.fill-lekarka-dnes-neordinuje.wh.t: U yerga borish: **na** + toʻldiruvchi shakli. Pohotovosť — undosh bilan tugaydigan ayol jinsidagi soʻz, shuning uchun oʻzgarmaydi: na **pohotovosť**. Na pohotovosti — u yerda boʻlish.

a2-u5-l7.speak-zavolaj-sanitku-marek.en.en: Call an ambulance! Marek has fallen.

en: Tomáš went to the hospital with Marek.
Tomáš went to hospital with Marek.
Tomáš went with Marek to the hospital.
t: Tomash Marek bilan birga kasalxonaga bordi.

a2-u5-l8.kde-vas-boli.note.en: To a friend: **Kde ťa bolí?** The answer can be just **Tu.** (Here.)
a2-u5-l8.kde-vas-boli.note.t: Doʻstga: **Kde ťa bolí?** (Qayering ogʻriyapti?) Javob shunchaki **Tu.** (Shu yer.) boʻlishi mumkin.

a2-u5-l8.choice-dobry-den-volam.question.en: Who is talking to Marek at A&E?
a2-u5-l8.choice-dobry-den-volam.question.t: Shoshilinch yordam boʻlimida Marek bilan kim gaplashyapti?

a2-u5-l8.zlomenina.note.en: From **zlomiť**: Je to zlomenina. = It's a fracture. The doctor sees it on the X-ray, the **snímka**.
a2-u5-l8.zlomenina.note.t: **zlomiť** soʻzidan: Je to zlomenina. = Suyak singan. Shifokor buni rentgen suratida — **snímka** da koʻradi.

a2-u5-l8.sadra.note.en: **Ruka bude v sadre** šesť týždňov. = The arm will be in plaster for six weeks.
a2-u5-l8.sadra.note.t: **Ruka bude v sadre** šesť týždňov. = Qoʻl olti hafta gipsda boʻladi.

a2-u5-l8.fill-ruka-bude-sest.en.en: The arm will be in plaster for six weeks.

a2-u5-l8.fill-ruka-bude-sest.why.en: **V** answering “where?” takes the locative, and sadra changes -a to **-e**: v **sadre**, like v škole.
a2-u5-l8.fill-ruka-bude-sest.why.t: «Qayerda?» savoliga javob beruvchi **v** lokál talab qiladi, sadra esa -a ni **-e** ga almashtiradi: v **sadre**, v škole kabi.

a2-u5-l8.byt-na-pn-ke.note.en: **PN** is said pé en, and a **PN-ka** (péenka) is a sick note. The official word is **práceneschopný**, unable to work.
a2-u5-l8.byt-na-pn-ke.note.t: **PN** «pe en» deb aytiladi, **PN-ka** (péenka) esa kasallik varaqasi (byulleten). Rasmiy soʻz — **práceneschopný**, mehnatga layoqatsiz.

en: He'll be in hospital for six weeks.
He'll be on sick leave for six weeks.
He has to come back in six weeks.
t: U olti hafta kasallik taʼtilida boʻladi.
U olti haftadan keyin qayta kelishi kerak.

a2-u5-l8.praca-vam-neutecie.note.en: Literally “work won't run away from you”, from **utiecť** (to run away). To a friend: **Práca ti neutečie.**
a2-u5-l8.praca-vam-neutecie.note.t: Aynan oʻzbekchadagi ibora: «ish sizdan qochib ketmaydi», **utiecť** (qochib ketmoq) feʼlidan. Doʻstga: **Práca ti neutečie.**

a2-u5-l8.build-ale-musim-ist.prompt.en: But I have to go to work, I'm a cook!
a2-u5-l8.build-ale-musim-ist.prompt.t: Lekin men ishga borishim kerak, men oshpazman!

en: You know **do práce** as a phrase: after do (to), práca changes -a to **-e**.
Marek is a man, so he's a **kuchár**. Kuchárka is a woman cook.
t: **do práce** ni tayyor ibora sifatida bilasiz: do (…ga) dan keyin práca -a ni **-e** ga almashtiradi.
Marek — erkak, shuning uchun u **kuchár**. Kuchárka — ayol oshpaz.

a2-u5-l8.fill-marek-praca-ti.en.en: Lucia to her brother: “Marek, work can wait!”

a2-u5-l8.fill-marek-praca-ti.why.en: Lucia is talking to her brother, so it's ty: práca **ti** neutečie. Veronika, his doctor, says vám.
a2-u5-l8.fill-marek-praca-ti.why.t: Lusiya akasi bilan gaplashyapti, shuning uchun ty: práca **ti** neutečie. Uning shifokori Veronika esa vám deydi.

a2-u5-l8.som-nahnevany.question.en: Marek can't cook for six weeks. What does he mean?
a2-u5-l8.som-nahnevany.question.t: Marek olti hafta ovqat pishira olmaydi. U nima demoqchi?

a2-u5-l8.fill-lucia-je-nahnevana.why.en: Lucia is a woman, so the adjective takes the feminine **-á**: nahnevan**á**.
a2-u5-l8.fill-lucia-je-nahnevana.why.t: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun sifat ayol jinsi qoʻshimchasi **-á** ni oladi: nahnevan**á**.

a2-u5-l8.choice-musite-si-oddychnut.ques.en: What does Veronika tell Marek before he goes home?
a2-u5-l8.choice-musite-si-oddychnut.ques.t: Marek uyga ketishidan oldin Veronika unga nima deydi?

You need to rest. Work can wait.
You can go back to work soon.
t: Kamroq ishlashingiz kerak. Dam olish qochib ketmaydi.
Dam olishingiz kerak. Ish qochib ketmaydi.

en: That young doctor was very nice.
The young doctor was very nice.
That young doctor was very kind.
The young doctor was very kind.
t: Oʻsha yosh shifokor juda yoqimli edi.

a2-u5-l9.hlava-a-krk.note.en: **krk** = neck. Slovaks also say Bolí ma krk for a sore throat.
a2-u5-l9.hlava-a-krk.note.t: **krk** = boʻyin. Slovaklar tomoq ogʻrigʻi haqida Bolí ma krk deb ham aytadi.

a2-u5-l9.rameno-a-ruka.note.en: **rameno** = shoulder (also **plece**). On the hand: **prsty** (fingers; one is a prst) and the **palec** (thumb).
a2-u5-l9.rameno-a-ruka.note.t: **rameno** = yelka (yana **plece**). Qoʻlda: **prsty** (barmoqlar; bittasi — prst) va **palec** (bosh barmoq).

a2-u5-l9.chrbat-a-brucho.note.en: Bolí ma chrbát. = My back hurts. Bolí ma brucho. = I've got a stomach ache.
a2-u5-l9.chrbat-a-brucho.note.t: Bolí ma chrbát. = Orqam (belim) ogʻriyapti. Bolí ma brucho. = Qornim ogʻriyapti.

a2-u5-l9.noha-a-koleno.note.en: Plurals: **nohy, kolená**. Noha is the leg and the foot.
a2-u5-l9.noha-a-koleno.note.t: Koʻplikda: **nohy, kolená**. Noha — ham butun oyoq, ham oyoq panjasi, oʻzbekchadagi «oyoq» kabi.

en: You know **Bolí ma hlava** and **Bolia ma zuby** from A1: what hurts is the subject of **bolieť**, so one thing **bolí**, more than one **bolia**, and the body part doesn't change.
The person in pain is the object, as in Emmu bolí hlava. Here are all the short forms, and a name: **Mareka** bolí ruka.
t: **Bolí ma hlava** va **Bolia ma zuby** ni A1 dan bilasiz: ogʻriyotgan narsa — **bolieť** feʼlining egasi, shuning uchun bitta narsa **bolí**, bir nechta narsa **bolia** boʻladi, tana aʼzosi esa oʻzgarmaydi. Oʻzbekchada feʼl koʻplikda ham oʻzgarmaydi (tishlarim ogʻriyapti), slovakchada esa oʻzgaradi.
Ogʻriyotgan odam — toʻldiruvchi, Emmu bolí hlava (Emmaning boshi ogʻriyapti) dagi kabi. Mana barcha qisqa shakllar va bitta ism: **Mareka** bolí ruka.

a2-u5-l9.fill-po-lyzovacke-ma.why.en: Nohy (legs) are more than one thing, and they're the subject, so the verb is **bolia**. Bolí is for one thing.
a2-u5-l9.fill-po-lyzovacke-ma.why.t: Nohy (oyoqlar) — bir nechta narsa va ular ega, shuning uchun feʼl **bolia**. Bolí — bitta narsa uchun.

a2-u5-l9.fill-mareka-boli.why.en: The arm is what hurts, the subject, so **ruka** doesn't change. Marek is the object: **Mareka**.
a2-u5-l9.fill-mareka-boli.why.t: Qoʻl — ogʻriyotgan narsa, ega, shuning uchun **ruka** oʻzgarmaydi. Marek esa toʻldiruvchi: **Mareka**.

a2-u5-l9.clenok-a-pata.note.en: A skier's injury: **Vyvrtol som si členok.** = I've sprained my ankle.
a2-u5-l9.clenok-a-pata.note.t: Changʻichining jarohati: **Vyvrtol som si členok.** = Toʻpigʻimni qayirib oldim.

a2-u5-l9.choice-ktora-veta-kolena.why.en: Kolená (knees) are more than one thing, so the verb is **bolia**. With one knee: Bolí ma koleno.
a2-u5-l9.choice-ktora-veta-kolena.why.t: Kolená (tizzalar) — bir nechta narsa, shuning uchun feʼl **bolia**. Bitta tizza bilan: Bolí ma koleno.

a2-u5-l9.fill-tomas-nemoze-hrat.en.en: Tomáš can't play football, his knee hurts.
a2-u5-l9.fill-tomas-nemoze-hrat.en.t: Tomash futbol oʻynay olmaydi, tizzasi ogʻriyapti.

a2-u5-l9.fill-tomas-nemoze-hrat.why.en: Tomáš is **on**, and the object form of on is **ho**: bolí **ho** koleno. Ju is for ona, ma for ja.
a2-u5-l9.fill-tomas-nemoze-hrat.why.t: Tomash — **on** (u), on ning toʻldiruvchi shakli esa **ho**: bolí **ho** koleno. Ju — ona uchun, ma — ja uchun.

en: One knee, one thing: **bolí**. Bolia is for more than one.
You're asking Tomáš himself (ty), so the object form is **ťa**. Ho would be him.
t: Bitta tizza, bitta narsa: **bolí**. Bolia — bir nechta narsa uchun.
Tomashning oʻzidan soʻrayapsiz (ty), shuning uchun toʻldiruvchi shakli **ťa** (seni). Ho — «uni» (erkakni) boʻlardi.

en: Lucia can't write, her finger hurts.
Lucia can't write because her finger hurts.
t: Lusiya yoza olmaydi, chunki barmogʻi ogʻriyapti.

a2-u5-l10.tvar.note.en: Feminine, like posteľ: tá tvár. Má peknú tvár. = She has a pretty face.
a2-u5-l10.tvar.note.t: posteľ kabi ayol jinsida: tá tvár. Má peknú tvár. = Uning yuzi chiroyli.

a2-u5-l10.oci-a-usi.note.en: One eye is **oko** and one ear **ucho**, but two are **oči** and **uši**, plurals of their own: Mám modré oči.
a2-u5-l10.oci-a-usi.note.t: Bitta koʻz — **oko**, bitta quloq — **ucho**, lekin ikkitasi — **oči** va **uši**, oʻzining alohida koʻplik shakli bilan: Mám modré oči. (Koʻzlarim koʻk.)

a2-u5-l10.nos-a-usta.note.en: **ústa** exists only in the plural: Ústa **sú**… In the mouth are **zuby** (teeth) and the **jazyk** (tongue); around it, the **pery** (lips).
a2-u5-l10.nos-a-usta.note.t: **ústa** faqat koʻplikda keladi: Ústa **sú**… Ogʻizda **zuby** (tishlar) va **jazyk** (til) bor, uning atrofida — **pery** (lablar).

a2-u5-l10.fill-veronika-ma-dlhe.why.en: Hair is plural in Slovak, **vlasy**, and so are its adjectives: dlhé tmavé **vlasy**.
a2-u5-l10.fill-veronika-ma-dlhe.why.t: Slovakchada soch koʻplikda keladi — **vlasy**, uning sifatlari ham: dlhé tmavé **vlasy**. Oʻzbekchada esa «soch» birlikda ham aytiladi.

a2-u5-l10.fill-veronika-ma-stihlu.why.en: Her figure is what she has, the object, so postava changes -a to **-u**, like štíhla → štíhl**u**: má štíhlu **postavu**.
a2-u5-l10.fill-veronika-ma-stihlu.why.t: Qomat — unda bor narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun postava -a ni **-u** ga almashtiradi, štíhla → štíhl**u** kabi: má štíhlu **postavu**.

a2-u5-l10.build-veronika-je-vysoka.promp.en: Veronika is tall and slim, she has big dark eyes.
a2-u5-l10.build-veronika-je-vysoka.promp.t: Veronika baland boʻyli va xipcha, uning katta qora koʻzlari bor.

en: Veronika is a woman, so the adjective is feminine. After the long í the ending stays short: **štíhla**, not štíhlá.
Two eyes are **oči**, a plural of its own. Oko is one eye.
t: Veronika — ayol, shuning uchun sifat ayol jinsida. Choʻziq í dan keyin qoʻshimcha qisqa qoladi: **štíhla**, štíhlá emas.
Ikki koʻz — **oči**, alohida koʻplik shakli. Oko — bitta koʻz.

a2-u5-l10.fill-tomas-je-vyssi.why.en: Comparing two people: **vyšší ako** = taller than.

a2-u5-l11.zubar.note.en: The everyday word for **zubný lekár**. Ísť **k zubárovi** = to go to the dentist.
a2-u5-l11.zubar.note.t: **zubný lekár** ning soʻzlashuvdagi nomi. Ísť **k zubárovi** = tish shifokoriga bormoq.

a2-u5-l11.vseobecny-lekar.note.en: Your first doctor, for colds, flu and sick notes.
a2-u5-l11.vseobecny-lekar.note.t: Birinchi murojaat qilinadigan shifokoringiz: shamollash, gripp va kasallik varaqasi uchun.

en: Many adjectives are made from nouns with **-ný** or **-ský**, and doctors are named this way: zub (tooth) → **zubný** lekár, a dentist.
They take the usual endings: zubný lekár, zubná lekárka, zubné problémy.
t: Koʻp sifatlar otlardan **-ný** yoki **-ský** bilan yasaladi, shifokorlar ham shunday nomlanadi: zub (tish) → **zubný** lekár, tish shifokori. Oʻzbekchada esa ot oʻzgarmasdan oldinda turadi: tish shifokori, koʻz shifokori.
Ular odatdagi qoʻshimchalarni oladi: zubný lekár, zubná lekárka, zubné problémy.

en: I've got toothache, I need a dentist.
Is your mum a children's doctor?
t: Tishim ogʻriyapti, menga tish shifokori kerak.

a2-u5-l11.choice-emma-boli-zub.question.en: Emma has toothache. Who does she go to?
a2-u5-l11.choice-emma-boli-zub.question.t: Emmaning tishi ogʻriyapti. U kimga boradi?

a2-u5-l11.choice-emma-boli-zub.why.en: A tooth is **zub**, so the tooth doctor is the **zubný** lekár, or zubár: k **zubárovi**.
a2-u5-l11.choice-emma-boli-zub.why.t: Tish — **zub**, shuning uchun tish shifokori — **zubný** lekár yoki zubár: k **zubárovi**.

a2-u5-l11.koza.note.en: So a skin doctor is a **kožný lekár**.

a2-u5-l11.nevidim-dobre.note.en: **vidieť** = to see, **počuť** = to hear: **Nepočujem dobre.** = I can't hear well.

a2-u5-l11.fill-nevidim-dobre-musim.en.en: I can't see well, I have to go to the eye doctor.
a2-u5-l11.fill-nevidim-dobre-musim.en.t: Yaxshi koʻrmayapman, koʻz shifokoriga borishim kerak.

a2-u5-l11.fill-nevidim-dobre-musim.why.en: You see with your eyes, **oči**, so the eye doctor is the **očný** lekár (after k, očnému).
a2-u5-l11.fill-nevidim-dobre-musim.why.t: Koʻzlar — **oči** bilan koʻrasiz, shuning uchun koʻz shifokori — **očný** lekár (k dan keyin očnému).

a2-u5-l11.fill-moja-sestra-je.en.en: My sister is a children's doctor, she works with children.
a2-u5-l11.fill-moja-sestra-je.en.t: Opam bolalar shifokori, u bolalar bilan ishlaydi.

a2-u5-l11.fill-moja-sestra-je.why.en: **Detský** comes from dieťa (child), and a woman doctor takes the feminine ending: **detská** lekárka.
a2-u5-l11.fill-moja-sestra-je.why.t: **Detský** dieťa (bola) soʻzidan yasalgan, ayol shifokor bilan esa ayol jinsi qoʻshimchasini oladi: **detská** lekárka.

a2-u5-l11.bolest.note.en: **bolesť hlavy** = a headache, **bolesť zubov** = toothache. Lucia's babka says a **prechádzka** (a walk) helps more than pills.
a2-u5-l11.bolest.note.t: **bolesť hlavy** = bosh ogʻrigʻi, **bolesť zubov** = tish ogʻrigʻi. Lusiyaning buvisi aytishicha, **prechádzka** (sayr) tabletkalardan koʻra koʻproq yordam beradi.

a2-u5-l11.choice-na-bolest-hlavy.questio.en: What helps a headache, says Lucia's grandmother?
a2-u5-l11.choice-na-bolest-hlavy.questio.t: Lusiyaning buvisi aytishicha, bosh ogʻrigʻiga nima yordam beradi?

a2-u5-l11.build-boli-ma-zub.prompt.en: I've got toothache, I'm going to the dentist.

en: Going **to** a person is **k** + the to-whom form: k **zubárovi**, like k lekárovi.
One tooth hurts, one thing, so it's **bolí**.
t: Odamning **oldiga** borish — **k** + «kimga?» shakli: k **zubárovi**, k lekárovi kabi.
Bitta tish ogʻriyapti, bitta narsa, shuning uchun **bolí**.

a2-u5-l11.choice-pan-kovac-nepocuje.ques.en: Pán Kováč says: Nepočujem dobre. Which doctor should he see?
a2-u5-l11.choice-pan-kovac-nepocuje.ques.t: Janob Kovach aytadi: Nepočujem dobre. U qaysi shifokorga borishi kerak?

a2-u5-l11.choice-pan-kovac-nepocuje.why.en: He can't hear well, and you hear with your ears, **uši**: the ear doctor, the **ušný** lekár.
a2-u5-l11.choice-pan-kovac-nepocuje.why.t: U yaxshi eshitmayapti, eshitish esa quloqlar — **uši** bilan: quloq shifokori, **ušný** lekár.

en: Lucia's mum works as a nurse in Žilina.
Lucia's mother works as a nurse in Žilina.
t: Lusiyaning onasi Jilinada hamshira boʻlib ishlaydi.
Lusiyaning oyisi Jilinada hamshira boʻlib ishlaydi.
Lusiyaning onasi hamshira boʻlib Jilinada ishlaydi.

a2-u5-l12.grammar-genitive-koho-coho.tit.en: The genitive: do, z, od, bez, u
a2-u5-l12.grammar-genitive-koho-coho.tit.t: Genitív: do, z, od, bez, u

en: You already know **do kina**, **do práce** and **z Írska**. After do, z and a few other little words, a noun takes the **genitive** (genitív), the “of” case. Its questions are **koho?** (whom?) and **čoho?** (what?). Koho? is also the object question you know (Koho hľadáš?); the end of this unit sorts the two out.
These little words are prepositions. Learn each one with its meaning: the genitive always follows them.
t: **do kina**, **do práce** va **z Írska** ni allaqachon bilasiz. do, z va yana bir nechta kichik soʻzlardan keyin ot **genitív** (qaratqich kelishigi) shaklida keladi. Uning savollari — **koho?** (kimning? kimdan?) va **čoho?** (nimaning? nimadan?). Koho? — sizga tanish toʻldiruvchi savoli ham (Koho hľadáš? — Kimni qidiryapsan?); boʻlim oxirida ikkalasini ajratamiz.
Bu kichik soʻzlar — predloglar. Oʻzbekchada ularning oʻrnida qoʻshimchalar bor: do — «-ga», z va od — «-dan», bez — «-siz». Har birini maʼnosi bilan birga yodlang: ulardan keyin doim genitív keladi.

en: Emma is going to the pharmacy.
I've got a prescription from the doctor.
Most feminine nouns change -a to **-y**: lekárka → od lekárk**y**. After a soft letter it's **-e**: nemocnica → z nemocnic**e**, and -ia becomes **-ie**: kancelária → z kancelári**e**.
Feminine nouns ending in a consonant take **-e** too: lekáreň → do lekárn**e**. Those in **-osť** take **-i**: pohotovosť → z pohotovost**i**.
t: Ayol jinsidagi koʻp otlarda -a **-y** ga aylanadi: lekárka → od lekárk**y**. Yumshoq harfdan keyin **-e** boʻladi: nemocnica → z nemocnic**e**, -ia esa **-ie** ga aylanadi: kancelária → z kancelári**e**.
Undosh bilan tugaydigan ayol jinsidagi otlar ham **-e** oladi: lekáreň → do lekárn**e**. **-osť** bilan tugaydiganlar **-i** oladi: pohotovosť → z pohotovost**i**.

en: Marek has come back from hospital.

a2-u5-l12.fill-emma-ide-do.en.en: Emma is going to the pharmacy.

a2-u5-l12.fill-emma-ide-do.why.en: **Do** takes the genitive. Lekáreň ends in a consonant, so it takes **-e** and drops its e: do **lekárne**. V lekárni is being there.
a2-u5-l12.fill-emma-ide-do.why.t: **Do** genitív talab qiladi. Lekáreň undosh bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun **-e** oladi va e ni tushiradi: do **lekárne**. V lekárni — u yerda boʻlish.

a2-u5-l12.fill-mam-recept-od.en.en: I've got a prescription from the doctor.

a2-u5-l12.fill-mam-recept-od.why.en: **Od** (from someone) takes the genitive, so lekárka changes -a to **-y**: od **lekárky**. Lekárku is the object form.
a2-u5-l12.fill-mam-recept-od.why.t: **Od** (kimdandir) genitív talab qiladi, shuning uchun lekárka -a ni **-y** ga almashtiradi: od **lekárky**. Lekárku — toʻldiruvchi shakli.

en: **Z** (from, out of) takes the genitive, and nemocnica has a soft c, so it's **-e**: z **nemocnice**. V nemocnici is the locative.
He came **from** the hospital, so it's **z**. Do means to, into.
t: **Z** (…dan, …ning ichidan) genitív talab qiladi, nemocnica esa yumshoq c bilan, shuning uchun **-e**: z **nemocnice**. V nemocnici — lokál.
U kasalxona**dan** keldi, shuning uchun **z**. Do — «…ga, …ning ichiga» degani.

a2-u5-l12.choice-emma-je-u.question.en: Which one means “Emma is at her friend's”?

a2-u5-l12.choice-emma-je-u.why.en: **U** + the genitive is being at someone's place: **u kamarátky**. Od kamarátky is coming from there, ku kamarátke going there.
a2-u5-l12.choice-emma-je-u.why.t: **U** + genitív — kimningdir uyida boʻlish: **u kamarátky**. Od kamarátky — u yerdan kelish, ku kamarátke — u yerga borish.

a2-u5-l12.fill-marek-sa-vratil-z.en.en: Marek has come back from A&E.

a2-u5-l12.fill-marek-sa-vratil-z.why.en: **Z** takes the genitive, and feminine nouns in **-osť** take **-i**: z **pohotovosti**.
a2-u5-l12.fill-marek-sa-vratil-z.why.t: **Z** genitív talab qiladi, **-osť** bilan tugaydigan ayol jinsidagi otlar esa **-i** oladi: z **pohotovosti**.

en: Neuter nouns in -o or -e take **-a**: mesto → do mest**a**, more → od mor**a**, srdce → bez srdc**a**. Those in -ie take **-ia**: námestie → z námesti**a**.
So kino gives do kin**a**, which you know. Dieťa adds -ťa: u dieťa**ťa**.
t: -o yoki -e bilan tugaydigan oʻrta jinsdagi otlar **-a** oladi: mesto → do mest**a**, more → od mor**a**, srdce → bez srdc**a**. -ie bilan tugaydiganlar **-ia** oladi: námestie → z námesti**a**.
Demak, kino dan sizga tanish do kin**a** hosil boʻladi. Dieťa -ťa qoʻshadi: u dieťa**ťa**.

a2-u5-l12.fill-kavu-pijem-bez.en.en: I drink my coffee without milk.

a2-u5-l12.fill-kavu-pijem-bez.why.en: **Bez** takes the genitive, and neuter mlieko changes -o to **-a**: bez **mlieka**. S mliekom is with milk.
a2-u5-l12.fill-kavu-pijem-bez.why.t: **Bez** genitív talab qiladi, oʻrta jinsdagi mlieko esa -o ni **-a** ga almashtiradi: bez **mlieka**. S mliekom — sut bilan.

a2-u5-l12.fill-tomas-ide-do.why.en: **Do** takes the genitive: mesto → do **mesta**, just like do kina.
a2-u5-l12.fill-tomas-ide-do.why.t: **Do** genitív talab qiladi: mesto → do **mesta**, xuddi do kina kabi.

a2-u5-l12.fill-autobus-ide-z.en.en: The bus leaves from the square.

a2-u5-l12.fill-autobus-ide-z.why.en: **Z** takes the genitive, and námestie, in -ie, takes **-ia**: z **námestia**.
a2-u5-l12.fill-autobus-ide-z.why.t: **Z** genitív talab qiladi, -ie bilan tugaydigan námestie esa **-ia** oladi: z **námestia**.

a2-u5-l13.grammar-genitive-masculine-peo.en: Men and animals: -a, like the object form
a2-u5-l13.grammar-genitive-masculine-peo.t: Erkaklar va hayvonlar: -a, toʻldiruvchi shakli kabi

en: For men and animals, the genitive is the same as the object form you know: Hľadám lekár**a**. → Som u lekár**a**. Names too: od Marek**a**, u Tomáš**a**.
Men's words in -a, like **kolega** (colleague), take **-u**: od koleg**u**. **pes** (dog) loses its e: bez ps**a**.
t: Erkaklar va hayvonlar uchun genitív sizga tanish toʻldiruvchi shakli bilan bir xil: Hľadám lekár**a**. (Shifokorni qidiryapman.) → Som u lekár**a**. (Shifokor qabulidaman.) Ismlar ham: od Marek**a**, u Tomáš**a**.
**kolega** (hamkasb) kabi -a bilan tugaydigan erkak soʻzlari **-u** oladi: od koleg**u**. **pes** (it) e ni tushiradi: bez ps**a**.

a2-u5-l13.fill-emma-bola-vcera.en.en: Emma went to the doctor's yesterday.

a2-u5-l13.fill-emma-bola-vcera.why.en: **U** takes the genitive, and a man adds **-a**, the same as the object form: u **lekára**.
a2-u5-l13.fill-emma-bola-vcera.why.t: **U** genitív talab qiladi, erkak esa **-a** oladi, toʻldiruvchi shakli bilan bir xil: u **lekára**.

a2-u5-l13.fill-lucia-je-dnes.why.en: **U** + the genitive: a man's name adds **-a**: u **Mareka**, at Marek's place.
a2-u5-l13.fill-lucia-je-dnes.why.t: **U** + genitív: erkak ismi **-a** oladi: u **Mareka** — Mareknikida.

en: Masculine things take **-u** or **-a**, and there's no sure rule: learn the genitive with the word. Many take -u: recept → bez recept**u**, čaj → bez čaj**u**, cukor → bez cukr**u**.

-a is usual in words in -ík and -ok (lístok → bez lístk**a**), parts of the body (zub → zub**a**, nos → do nos**a**), days and months (pondelok → od pondelk**a**), and in chlieb, syr and stôl: chleb**a**, syr**a**, stol**a**.
Before s, z, š or ž, z becomes **zo**: zo stola, zo Žiliny. You get on with **nastúpiť do** and off with **vystúpiť z**: do autobusu, z vlaku.
t: Erkak jinsidagi narsalar **-u** yoki **-a** oladi, aniq qoida yoʻq: genitívni soʻz bilan birga yodlang. Koʻplari -u oladi: recept → bez recept**u**, čaj → bez čaj**u**, cukor → bez cukr**u**.

-a odatda -ík va -ok bilan tugaydigan soʻzlarda (lístok → bez lístk**a**), tana aʼzolarida (zub → zub**a**, nos → do nos**a**), kunlar va oylarda (pondelok → od pondelk**a**), shuningdek chlieb, syr va stôl da keladi: chleb**a**, syr**a**, stol**a**.
s, z, š yoki ž oldida z **zo** ga aylanadi: zo stola, zo Žiliny. Transportga **nastúpiť do** bilan chiqasiz, **vystúpiť z** bilan tushasiz: do autobusu (avtobusga), z vlaku (poyezddan).

I'll get off the bus at the hospital.

a2-u5-l13.fill-pijem-caj-bez.why.en: **Bez** takes the genitive. Cukor takes **-u** and drops its o: bez **cukru**. S cukrom is with sugar.
a2-u5-l13.fill-pijem-caj-bez.why.t: **Bez** genitív talab qiladi. Cukor **-u** oladi va o ni tushiradi: bez **cukru**. S cukrom — shakar bilan.

a2-u5-l13.fill-tento-sirup-je.en.en: This syrup is over the counter.

a2-u5-l13.fill-tento-sirup-je.why.en: **Bez** takes the genitive, and recept takes **-u**: bez **receptu**.
a2-u5-l13.fill-tento-sirup-je.why.t: **Bez** genitív talab qiladi, recept esa **-u** oladi: bez **receptu**.

a2-u5-l13.choice-telefon-spadol-zo.why.en: Stôl takes **-a** and loses its ô: stola. Before s, z becomes **zo**: **zo stola**.
a2-u5-l13.choice-telefon-spadol-zo.why.t: Stôl **-a** oladi va ô ni yoʻqotadi: stola. s oldida z **zo** ga aylanadi: **zo stola**.

a2-u5-l13.fill-tomas-vystupil-z.en.en: Tomáš got off the train in Bratislava.

a2-u5-l13.fill-tomas-vystupil-z.why.en: **Vystúpiť z** (to get off) takes the genitive, and vlak takes **-u**: z **vlaku**. Vlakom is by train.
a2-u5-l13.fill-tomas-vystupil-z.why.t: **Vystúpiť z** (tushmoq) genitív talab qiladi, vlak esa **-u** oladi: z **vlaku**. Vlakom — poyezdda.

en: Getting off is **vystúpiť** (z), getting on is nastúpiť (do).
After **mám** (should I), the verb takes the -ť form: mám **vystúpiť**.
t: **Mám** (…ishim kerak) dan keyin feʼl -ť shaklida keladi: mám **vystúpiť**.

a2-u5-l13.build-idem-do-obchodu.prompt.en: I'm going to the shop for bread.

en: **Do** takes the genitive, and obchod takes **-u**: do **obchodu**.
**Po** (to get) takes the object form, so chlieb doesn't change: po **chlieb**. Chleba is the genitive.
t: **Do** genitív talab qiladi, obchod esa **-u** oladi: do **obchodu**.
**Po** (…ni olgani) toʻldiruvchi shaklini talab qiladi, shuning uchun chlieb oʻzgarmaydi: po **chlieb**. Chleba — genitív.

a2-u5-l13.fill-mam-spravu-od.en.en: Tomáš has a message from a colleague.

a2-u5-l13.fill-mam-spravu-od.why.en: Men's words in -a, like kolega, take **-u** in the genitive: od **kolegu**.
a2-u5-l13.fill-mam-spravu-od.why.t: kolega kabi -a bilan tugaydigan erkak soʻzlari genitívda **-u** oladi: od **kolegu**.

a2-u5-l13.choice-ktore-slovo-ma.question.en: Which word takes -a in the genitive?

a2-u5-l13.choice-ktore-slovo-ma.why.en: Parts of the body usually take **-a**: bez **zuba**. Čaj and recept take -u: bez čaju, bez receptu.
a2-u5-l13.choice-ktore-slovo-ma.why.t: Tana aʼzolari odatda **-a** oladi: bez **zuba**. Čaj va recept -u oladi: bez čaju, bez receptu.

a2-u5-l14.grammar-genitive-adjectives-te.en: Adjectives and ten in the genitive

en: Adjectives and ten change with their noun. Masculine and neuter: **-ého**, **toho**. Feminine: **-ej**, **tej**.
You know -ého from the object form of men (nového kamaráta) and -ej from the locative (vo veľkej firme).
t: Sifatlar va ten oʻz oti bilan birga oʻzgaradi. Erkak va oʻrta jins: **-ého**, **toho**. Ayol jinsi: **-ej**, **tej**.
-ého ni erkaklarning toʻldiruvchi shaklidan (nového kamaráta), -ej ni esa lokáldan (vo veľkej firme) bilasiz.

I'm going to that new shop.

en: Possessives change like adjectives: **môjho**, tvojho, nášho, vášho with masculine and neuter nouns, **mojej**, tvojej, našej, vašej with feminine ones. **Svoj** (your own) too: svojho, svojej.
**Jeho**, **jej** and **ich** never change, as you know.
t: Egalik olmoshlari sifatlar kabi oʻzgaradi: erkak va oʻrta jinsdagi otlar bilan **môjho**, tvojho, nášho, vášho, ayol jinsidagilar bilan **mojej**, tvojej, našej, vašej. **Svoj** (oʻzining) ham: svojho, svojej.
**Jeho**, **jej** va **ich** hech qachon oʻzgarmaydi, buni bilasiz.

en: I've got a present from my brother.

a2-u5-l14.fill-mam-kvapky-od.en.en: I've got drops from our doctor.

a2-u5-l14.fill-mam-kvapky-od.why.en: **Od** takes the genitive, and a possessive with a feminine noun ends in **-ej**: od **našej** lekárky.
a2-u5-l14.fill-mam-kvapky-od.why.t: **Od** genitív talab qiladi, ayol jinsidagi ot bilan egalik olmoshi esa **-ej** bilan tugaydi: od **našej** lekárky.

a2-u5-l14.fill-idem-do-toho.en.en: I'm going to that new shop.

a2-u5-l14.fill-idem-do-toho.why.en: **Do** takes the genitive. Obchod is masculine, so the adjective ends in **-ého**, like toho: do toho **nového** obchodu.
a2-u5-l14.fill-idem-do-toho.why.t: **Do** genitív talab qiladi. Obchod — erkak jinsida, shuning uchun sifat toho kabi **-ého** bilan tugaydi: do toho **nového** obchodu.

a2-u5-l14.fill-marek-sa-vratil-z-tej.en.en: Marek has come back from that big hospital.

a2-u5-l14.fill-marek-sa-vratil-z-tej.why.en: **Z** takes the genitive, and with a feminine noun tá becomes **tej**, like veľkej: z **tej** veľkej nemocnice.
a2-u5-l14.fill-marek-sa-vratil-z-tej.why.t: **Z** genitív talab qiladi, ayol jinsidagi ot bilan esa tá xuddi veľkej kabi **tej** ga aylanadi: z **tej** veľkej nemocnice.

en: To say whose something is, put the owner after it, in the genitive: preukaz **Emmy**, Emma's card; telefón **môjho brata**, my brother's phone. You can ask Čí je to…?, or, as people often do, **Koho je to…?**
The same “of” form follows other nouns too: koniec **týždňa** (the end of the week), centrum **mesta** (the town centre), preukaz **poistenca**.
t: Narsa kimniki ekanini aytish uchun egasini narsadan keyin, genitívda qoʻying: preukaz **Emmy** — Emmaning kartasi; telefón **môjho brata** — akamning telefoni. Oʻzbekchada aksincha: egasi oldin, -ning bilan keladi. Čí je to…? deb soʻrashingiz mumkin yoki, odamlar koʻpincha qilganidek, **Koho je to…?**
Xuddi shu «-ning» shakli boshqa otlardan keyin ham keladi: koniec **týždňa** (haftaning oxiri), centrum **mesta** (shahar markazi), preukaz **poistenca**.

a2-u5-l14.choice-lucia-najde-preukaz.que.en: Lucia finds a card on the table. How does she ask whose it is?

a2-u5-l14.choice-lucia-najde-preukaz.why.en: Whose? asks for the owner in the genitive: **koho** (the genitive of kto) + je to: **Koho** je to preukaz? Kto je to? asks who someone is.
a2-u5-l14.choice-lucia-najde-preukaz.why.t: Kimning? — egasini genitívda soʻraydi: **koho** (kto ning genitívi) + je to: **Koho** je to preukaz? Kto je to? esa kimdir kimligini soʻraydi.

a2-u5-l14.fill-to-je-preukaz.why.en: The owner comes after the thing, in the genitive: Emma → preukaz **Emmy**.
a2-u5-l14.fill-to-je-preukaz.why.t: Egasi narsadan keyin, genitívda keladi: Emma → preukaz **Emmy**.

en: The owner, my brother, goes after the phone in the genitive, so môj becomes **môjho**.
The owner is in the genitive: brat → **brata**, like the object form.
t: Egasi — akam — telefondan keyin genitívda keladi, shuning uchun môj **môjho** ga aylanadi.
Egasi genitívda: brat → **brata**, toʻldiruvchi shakli kabi.

a2-u5-l14.fill-na-konci-tyzdna.en.en: At the end of the week I'll go for a check-up.

a2-u5-l14.fill-na-konci-tyzdna.why.en: “Of the week” after konci is the genitive, and týždeň loses its e: **týždňa**.
a2-u5-l14.fill-na-konci-tyzdna.why.t: konci dan keyingi «haftaning» — genitív, týždeň esa e ni yoʻqotadi: **týždňa**.

a2-u5-l14.build-lucia-je-v.prompt.en: Lucia is in her brother's flat.

en: The brother is Lucia's own, and Lucia is the subject, so Slovak uses **svoj**: v byte **svojho** brata.
The owner goes after the flat, in the genitive: **brata**.
t: Aka — Lusiyaning oʻz akasi, Lusiya esa ega, shuning uchun slovakchada **svoj** ishlatiladi, oʻzbekchadagi «oʻzining» kabi: v byte **svojho** brata.

a2-u5-l14.fill-lekaren-je-v.en.en: The pharmacy is in the town centre.

a2-u5-l14.fill-lekaren-je-v.why.en: The centre **of** the town: the genitive after centre, **mesta**.
a2-u5-l14.fill-lekaren-je-v.why.t: Shahar**ning** markazi: centre dan keyin genitív keladi, **mesta**.

en: My friend's sister is a doctor.

In the plural, masculine nouns end in **-ov**, people and things alike: lekár → lekár**ov**, liek → liek**ov**, zub → zub**ov**. A few everyday ones, like ľudia, peniaze and dni, are irregular (next card).
Adjectives and ten end in **-ých** for every gender: t**ých** nov**ých** liekov. Possessives end in **-ich**: mojich, tvojich, našich, vašich, svojich.
t: Koʻplikda erkak jinsidagi otlar **-ov** bilan tugaydi, odamlar ham, narsalar ham: lekár → lekár**ov**, liek → liek**ov**, zub → zub**ov**. ľudia, peniaze va dni kabi bir nechta kundalik soʻzlar istisno (keyingi kartochka).
Sifatlar va ten har qanday jinsda **-ých** bilan tugaydi: t**ých** nov**ých** liekov. Egalik olmoshlari **-ich** bilan tugaydi: mojich, tvojich, našich, vašich, svojich.

a2-u5-l15.grammar-genitive-plural-fem-ne.en: Feminine and neuter: no ending, or -í
a2-u5-l15.grammar-genitive-plural-fem-ne.t: Ayol va oʻrta jins: qoʻshimchasiz yoki -í

en: Feminine nouns in -a and neuter nouns in -o lose their ending: kniha → kníh, nemocnica → nemocníc, mesto → miest, auto → áut. The last syllable usually gets longer (see the next card).
Feminine words ending in a consonant, words in -ia and neuter words in -ie take **-í**: lekáreň → lekárn**í**, vec → vec**í**, reštaurácia → reštaurác**ií**, námestie → námest**í**.
A few everyday words are irregular: ľudia → **ľudí**, deti → **detí**, peniaze → **peňazí**, dni → **dní**, oči → **očí**, uši → **uší**.
t: -a bilan tugaydigan ayol jinsidagi va -o bilan tugaydigan oʻrta jinsdagi otlar qoʻshimchasini yoʻqotadi: kniha → kníh, nemocnica → nemocníc, mesto → miest, auto → áut. Oxirgi boʻgʻin odatda choʻziladi (keyingi kartochkaga qarang).

Undosh bilan tugaydigan ayol jinsidagi soʻzlar, -ia bilan tugaydigan soʻzlar va -ie bilan tugaydigan oʻrta jinsdagi soʻzlar **-í** oladi: lekáreň → lekárn**í**, vec → vec**í**, reštaurácia → reštaurác**ií**, námestie → námest**í**.
Bir nechta kundalik soʻzlar istisno: ľudia → **ľudí**, deti → **detí**, peniaze → **peňazí**, dni → **dní**, oči → **očí**, uši → **uší**.

a2-u5-l15.fill-lucia-je-cez.why.t: **U** genitív talab qiladi, koʻplikda erkak jinsidagi soʻzlar esa **-ov** bilan tugaydi: u **rodičov**.

a2-u5-l15.choice-mesto-bez-aut.question.en: Which one means “a town without cars”?

a2-u5-l15.choice-mesto-bez-aut.why.en: Cars, plural: auto loses its ending in the genitive plural, and a becomes á: bez **áut**. Bez auta is without one car.
a2-u5-l15.choice-mesto-bez-aut.why.t: Mashinalar, koʻplik: koʻplikdagi genitívda auto qoʻshimchasini yoʻqotadi, a esa á ga aylanadi: bez **áut**. Bez auta — bitta mashinasiz.

a2-u5-l15.fill-mam-pozdrav-od.en.en: I've got greetings from my friends.

a2-u5-l15.fill-mam-pozdrav-od.why.en: Possessives in the genitive plural end in **-ich**: od **mojich** kamarátov.
a2-u5-l15.fill-mam-pozdrav-od.why.t: Koʻplikdagi genitívda egalik olmoshlari **-ich** bilan tugaydi: od **mojich** kamarátov.

a2-u5-l15.choice-genitiv-ludia.question.en: Which is the genitive plural of ľudia (people)?

a2-u5-l15.choice-genitiv-ludia.why.en: **Ľudia** is irregular: **ľudí**, like detí and peňazí.

en: When the ending drops, the last syllable gets longer: a → á (mapa → máp), i → í (kniha → kníh), u → ú (ruka → rúk), o → ô (noha → nôh), e → ie (žena → žien), ä → ia (fľaša → fliaš), even r → ŕ and l → ĺ (srdce → sŕdc, jablko → jabĺk).

Two consonants at the end get a vowel between them: **-ie-** (tabletka → tablet**ie**k), but **-o-** after a long syllable (kamarátka → kamarát**o**k). A syllable that is already long stays: práca → prác.
t: Qoʻshimcha tushib qolganda oxirgi boʻgʻin choʻziladi: a → á (mapa → máp), i → í (kniha → kníh), u → ú (ruka → rúk), o → ô (noha → nôh), e → ie (žena → žien), ä → ia (fľaša → fliaš), hatto r → ŕ va l → ĺ (srdce → sŕdc, jablko → jabĺk).

Oxirida ikki undosh qolsa, ular orasiga unli qoʻshiladi: **-ie-** (tabletka → tablet**ie**k), lekin choʻziq boʻgʻindan keyin **-o-** (kamarátka → kamarát**o**k). Allaqachon choʻziq boʻgʻin oʻzgarmaydi: práca → prác.

en: I can't sleep without those tablets.
It's a present from my friends.

a2-u5-l15.fill-emma-ide-domov.en.en: Emma is going home from her lectures.

a2-u5-l15.fill-emma-ide-domov.why.en: **Z** takes the genitive. Prednáška loses its ending, and š-k gets a vowel between them; after the long á it's **-o-**: z **prednášok**.
a2-u5-l15.fill-emma-ide-domov.why.t: **Z** genitív talab qiladi. Prednáška qoʻshimchasini yoʻqotadi, š va k orasiga unli qoʻshiladi; choʻziq á dan keyin bu **-o-**: z **prednášok**.

a2-u5-l15.fill-je-to-darcek.en.en: It's a present from my (girl) friends.

a2-u5-l15.fill-je-to-darcek.why.en: **Od** takes the genitive. In the plural kamarátka has no ending; t-k gets **-o-** between them, after the long á: **kamarátok**.
a2-u5-l15.fill-je-to-darcek.why.t: **Od** genitív talab qiladi. Koʻplikda kamarátka qoʻshimchasiz keladi; choʻziq á dan keyin t va k orasiga **-o-** qoʻshiladi: **kamarátok**.

a2-u5-zamena.grammar-genitive-pronouns.t.en: Pronouns: u mňa, od teba, bez neho
a2-u5-zamena.grammar-genitive-pronouns.t.t: Olmoshlar: u mňa, od teba, bez neho

en: After a preposition with the genitive, pronouns take these forms: **mňa, teba, neho, nej, nás, vás, nich**. Before mňa, od, bez and z add an -o: **odo mňa**, **bezo mňa**, **zo mňa**.
Most of them look like the forms after pre (pre mňa, pre neho). Only ona is different: pre **ňu**, but od **nej**.
t: Genitív talab qiluvchi predlogdan keyin olmoshlar shu shakllarda keladi: **mňa, teba, neho, nej, nás, vás, nich**. mňa oldidan od, bez va z ga -o qoʻshiladi: **odo mňa** (mendan), **bezo mňa** (mensiz), **zo mňa**.
Ularning koʻpi pre dan keyingi shakllarga oʻxshaydi (pre mňa, pre neho). Faqat ona boshqacha: pre **ňu**, lekin od **nej**.

a2-u5-l18.grammar-verbs-with-genitive.ti.t: Genitív talab qiluvchi feʼllar: báť sa, opýtať sa

en: A few verbs take the genitive with no preposition: **báť sa** (to be afraid of: bojím sa, bojíš sa…) and **opýtať sa** (to ask someone): Bojím sa pavúkov. Opýtam sa lekárky.
Pronouns use their short forms here: **ma, ťa, ho, jej, nás, vás, ich**. Stressed, they get longer: **mňa, teba, jeho**. Opýtaj sa ho! – Prečo **jeho**? – Pretože on to vie.
t: Bir nechta feʼl predlogsiz genitív talab qiladi: **báť sa** (…dan qoʻrqmoq: bojím sa, bojíš sa…) va **opýtať sa** (kimdandir soʻramoq): Bojím sa pavúkov. (Oʻrgimchaklardan qoʻrqaman.) Opýtam sa lekárky. (Shifokordan soʻrayman.) Oʻzbekchada ikkalasi ham -dan bilan keladi.

Bu yerda olmoshlar qisqa shakllarda keladi: **ma, ťa, ho, jej, nás, vás, ich**. Urgʻu tushganda ular uzayadi: **mňa, teba, jeho**. Opýtaj sa ho! – Prečo **jeho**? – Pretože on to vie. (Undan soʻra! – Nega aynan undan? – Chunki u buni biladi.)

a2-u5-l18.fill-emma-sa-boji.en.en: Emma is afraid of the dentist.

a2-u5-l18.fill-emma-sa-boji.why.en: **Báť sa** takes the genitive, and a man adds **-a**: bojí sa **zubára**.
a2-u5-l18.fill-emma-sa-boji.why.t: **Báť sa** genitív talab qiladi, erkak esa **-a** oladi: bojí sa **zubára**.

a2-u5-l18.fill-opytam-sa-lekarky.en.en: I'll ask the doctor when I can cook.
a2-u5-l18.fill-opytam-sa-lekarky.en.t: Shifokordan qachon ovqat pishira olishimni soʻrayman.

a2-u5-l18.fill-opytam-sa-lekarky.why.en: **Opýtať sa** takes the genitive, so lekárka changes -a to **-y**: opýtam sa **lekárky**. Lekárku is the object form.
a2-u5-l18.fill-opytam-sa-lekarky.why.t: **Opýtať sa** genitív talab qiladi, shuning uchun lekárka -a ni **-y** ga almashtiradi: opýtam sa **lekárky**. Lekárku — toʻldiruvchi shakli.

a2-u5-l18.choice-opytaj-sa-tomasa.questi.en: Why does the second speaker say jeho, not ho?
a2-u5-l18.choice-opytaj-sa-tomasa.questi.t: Nega ikkinchi odam ho emas, jeho deydi?

t: Unga urgʻu tushgan: nega aynan u?

a2-u5-l18.choice-opytaj-sa-tomasa.why.en: With stress, the short form ho gets longer: **jeho**. After a preposition it would be neho.
a2-u5-l18.choice-opytaj-sa-tomasa.why.t: Urgʻu tushganda qisqa ho uzayadi: **jeho**. Predlogdan keyin esa neho boʻlardi.

a2-u5-l18.build-nebojim-sa-ho.prompt.en: The dog? I'm not afraid of it.

en: No preposition here, so the short form: nebojím sa **ho**. Neho comes after a preposition, like od neho.
**Báť sa** takes the genitive: **ho**. Mu is the to-whom form.
t: Bu yerda predlog yoʻq, shuning uchun qisqa shakl: nebojím sa **ho**. Neho predlogdan keyin keladi, masalan od neho.
**Báť sa** genitív talab qiladi: **ho**. Mu — «kimga?» shakli.

en: Slovak has six cases, and each has its question. Asking it is a quick way to find the right form.
Koho? belongs to two cases: the genitive (Koho sa bojíš?) and the object form (Koho hľadáš?).
t: Slovak tilida, oʻzbek tilidagi kabi, oltita kelishik bor, va har birining oʻz savoli bor. Savolni berish — toʻgʻri shaklni topishning tez yoʻli.
Koho? ikki kelishikka tegishli: genitív (Koho sa bojíš? — Kimdan qoʻrqasan?) va toʻldiruvchi shakli (Koho hľadáš? — Kimni qidiryapsan?).

en: Who are you afraid of? — The dentist.
What are you afraid of? — Heights.

a2-u5-l18.fill-koho-sa-bojis.en.en: Who are you afraid of? — The dentist.

a2-u5-l18.fill-koho-sa-bojis.why.en: **Báť sa** takes the genitive, so the question is **Koho**?, and the answer, zubára, is in the genitive too.
a2-u5-l18.fill-koho-sa-bojis.why.t: **Báť sa** genitív talab qiladi, shuning uchun savol — **Koho**?, javob — zubára ham genitívda.

a2-u5-l18.choice-ktory-pad-po.question.en: Which case comes after vedľa (next to)?
a2-u5-l18.choice-ktory-pad-po.question.t: vedľa (yonida) dan keyin qaysi kelishik keladi?

a2-u5-l18.choice-ktory-pad-po.why.en: **Vedľa** takes the genitive, like blízko and okolo: vedľa pošty. Pri (by) takes the locative, pred and za the instrumental.
a2-u5-l18.choice-ktory-pad-po.why.t: **Vedľa** blízko va okolo kabi genitív talab qiladi: vedľa pošty. Pri (yonida) lokál, pred va za esa inštrumentál talab qiladi.

a2-u5-l18.build-emma-caka-pred.prompt.en: Emma is waiting in front of the pharmacy, next to the post office.
a2-u5-l18.build-emma-caka-pred.prompt.t: Emma dorixona oldida, pochta yonida kutyapti.

en: **Pred** (in front of) takes the “with” form, the instrumental: pred **lekárňou**. Lekárne is the genitive.
**Vedľa** takes the genitive: vedľa **pošty**. Pošte is the locative, as after pri or na.
t: **Pred** (oldida) «bilan» shaklini — inštrumentálni talab qiladi: pred **lekárňou**. Lekárne — genitív.
**Vedľa** genitív talab qiladi: vedľa **pošty**. Pošte — lokál, pri yoki na dan keyingi kabi.

a2-u5-l18.choice-lekaren-je-pri.why.en: **Pri** (by) takes the locative: pri **pošte**. Vedľa, with the same meaning, takes the genitive: vedľa pošty.
a2-u5-l18.choice-lekaren-je-pri.why.t: **Pri** (yonida) lokál talab qiladi: pri **pošte**. Xuddi shu maʼnodagi vedľa esa genitív talab qiladi: vedľa pošty.

en: Marek asked the doctor when he can cook.
Marek asked the doctor when he could cook.
t: Marek shifokordan qachon ovqat pishira olishini soʻradi.
Marek shifokordan qachon ovqat qila olishini soʻradi.

a2-u5-pisanie.listen-prechladla-som-a.en.en: I've caught a cold and I've got a runny nose.

a2-u5-pisanie.listen-mate-preukaz-poiste.en: Have you got your health insurance card?

a2-u5-pisanie.listen-uzivajte-jednu-tabl.en: Take one tablet three times a day.
a2-u5-pisanie.listen-uzivajte-jednu-tabl.t: Kuniga uch marta bittadan tabletka iching.

a2-u5-pisanie.listen-veronika-je-lekarka.en: Veronika is a doctor at the hospital.

a2-u5-pisanie.listen-boli-ma-chrbat.en.en: My back hurts and my legs hurt.

a2-u5-pisanie.listen-lekaren-je-blizko.e.en: The pharmacy is near the dorm.

a2-u5-l19.fill-emma-ide-do.en.en: Emma is going to the pharmacy with her prescription.

a2-u5-l19.fill-emma-ide-do.why.en: **Do** takes the genitive: lekáreň → do **lekárne**. V lekárni is being there.
a2-u5-l19.fill-emma-ide-do.why.t: **Do** genitív talab qiladi: lekáreň → do **lekárne**. V lekárni — u yerda boʻlish.

a2-u5-l19.build-zlomila-som-si-nohu.prom.en: I've broken my leg. (a woman speaking)

en: The leg is what you broke, the object, so noha changes -a to **-u**: **nohu**.
Breaking a part of your own body is **zlomiť si**: zlomila som **si** nohu.
t: Oyoq — siz sindirgan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun noha -a ni **-u** ga almashtiradi: **nohu**.
Oʻz tana aʼzoingizni sindirish — **zlomiť si**: zlomila som **si** nohu.

a2-u5-l19.choice-uzivajte-jednu-tabletku.en: Listen. How often should you take the tablet?
a2-u5-l19.choice-uzivajte-jednu-tabletku.t: Tinglang. Tabletkani necha marta ichish kerak?

a2-u5-l19.fill-po-lyzovacke-ma.why.en: Ramená (shoulders) are more than one thing, the subject, so the verb is **bolia**.
a2-u5-l19.fill-po-lyzovacke-ma.why.t: Ramená (yelkalar) — bir nechta narsa, ega, shuning uchun feʼl **bolia**.

a2-u5-l19.build-mate-preukaz-poistenca.p.en: Have you got your health insurance card?

en: The nurse calls a patient **vy**, so it's **Máte**…? Máš is for a friend.
The card **of** an insured person: the genitive, **poistenca**.
t: Hamshira bemorga vy (siz) deydi, shuning uchun **Máte**…? Máš — doʻst uchun.

a2-u5-l19.fill-v-cakarni-sedelo.en.en: Five patients were sitting in the waiting room.
a2-u5-l19.fill-v-cakarni-sedelo.en.t: Kutish xonasida besh bemor oʻtirgan edi.

a2-u5-l19.fill-v-cakarni-sedelo.why.en: From five up the noun takes the genitive plural, masculine **-ov**: päť **pacientov**, and the verb is singular: sedelo.
a2-u5-l19.fill-v-cakarni-sedelo.why.t: Beshdan boshlab ot koʻplikdagi genitívda keladi, erkak jinsida **-ov** bilan: päť **pacientov**, feʼl esa birlikda: sedelo.

a2-u5-l19.choice-boli-ma-zub.question.en: Bolí ma zub. Who do you go to?

a2-u5-l19.choice-boli-ma-zub.why.en: A tooth is **zub**, so you go to the **zubár**, the zubný lekár.
a2-u5-l19.choice-boli-ma-zub.why.t: Tish — **zub**, shuning uchun **zubár** ga, yaʼni zubný lekár ga borasiz.

a2-u5-l19.fill-tomas-bez-neho.en.en: Tomáš? I'm not going skiing without him.

a2-u5-l19.fill-tomas-bez-neho.why.en: After the preposition **bez**, on is **neho**. Ho is the short form without a preposition, ním goes with s.
a2-u5-l19.fill-tomas-bez-neho.why.t: **bez** predlogidan keyin on **neho** boʻladi. Ho — predlogsiz qisqa shakl, ním s bilan keladi.

en: Without is **bez**. S cukrom would be with sugar.

a2-u5-l19.fill-to-je-preukaz.why.en: The owner goes after the card, in the genitive: môjho **brata**.
a2-u5-l19.fill-to-je-preukaz.why.t: Egasi kartadan keyin, genitívda keladi: môjho **brata**.

en: The pharmacy is in the hospital.
The pharmacy is far from the hospital.
The pharmacy is next to the hospital.

a2-u5-l19.fill-dam-si-salku.en.en: I'll have a cup of coffee with milk.

a2-u5-l19.fill-dam-si-salku.why.en: A cup **of** coffee: after šálku, the genitive: káva → **kávy**.
a2-u5-l19.fill-dam-si-salku.why.t: Bir chashka qahva: šálku dan keyin genitív keladi: káva → **kávy**.

en: Marek will be on sick leave until April.
Marek is on sick leave until April.

a2-u5-l19.fill-opytam-sa-jej.why.en: **Opýtať sa** takes the genitive, with no preposition, so ona is **jej**. Nej comes after a preposition, ju is the object form.
a2-u5-l19.fill-opytam-sa-jej.why.t: **Opýtať sa** predlogsiz genitív talab qiladi, shuning uchun ona **jej** boʻladi. Nej predlogdan keyin keladi, ju — toʻldiruvchi shakli.
